info.name: Atlassian Admin Account Project Email API
Atlassian Get Project S Sender Email

items.docs:
Returns the [project's sender email address](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/dolKLg).

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Browse projects* [project permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/yodKLg) for the project.

info.name: Atlassian Set Project S Sender Email

items.docs:
Sets the [project's sender email address](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/dolKLg).

If `emailAddress` is an empty string, the default email address is restored.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Administer Jira* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg) or *Administer Projects* [project permission.](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/yodKLg)
